simple.meaning: עִמָּד (ʻimmâd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “along with.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 3:12. The surrounding context includes family, family line, kingship, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עִמָּד (H5978) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
